name: FinalBurn Neo
description: An arcade emulator that recreates a large collection of classic arcade boards rather than a single machine, from Capcom CPS-1/2/3 and Neo Geo to Sega System 16, Toaplan and Cave. It continues the FinalBurn and FinalBurn Alpha lineage and is widely used for online play.

specs.cpu: Mostly Motorola 68000 and Zilog Z80 based boards
specs.sound: Mostly Yamaha FM and OKI ADPCM chips

curiosities: FinalBurn Neo was forked from FinalBurn Alpha in 2019.
It is the emulator used by the Fightcade online play service.
Besides arcade boards it also emulates several home systems, such as the Mega Drive and PC Engine.
